# SD STEM Ecosystem

> A directory of STEM learning opportunities (camps, out-of-school programs,
> work-based learning) run by San Diego-area partner organizations. The
> underlying data is published as plain, statically-served JSON: no auth, no
> API key, no rate limit imposed by us.

## Data

- [partners.json](https://league-infrastructure.github.io/partner-scrape/data/partners.json): Partner roster envelope (`generated_at`, `partner_count`, `partners[]`). Each partner entry has a `slug`, `events_url`, and `past_events_url` (both relative to `.../data/`).
- Per-partner events, one pair per partner listed in `partners.json`: `https://league-infrastructure.github.io/partner-scrape/data/partners/<slug>/events.json` and `https://league-infrastructure.github.io/partner-scrape/data/partners/<slug>/past-events.json`. `current`/`past` is a true partition — undated records land in `past-events.json`, nothing is dropped.
- [teams.json](https://league-infrastructure.github.io/partner-scrape/data/teams.json): FIRST/VEX robotics teams directory for San Diego County: id, league, grade band, organization, location w/ precision, status, sponsors. Self-describing `meta` envelope (`generated`, `total`, `by_league`, `by_location_precision`).

## Documentation

- [How to Consume Our Data](https://league-infrastructure.github.io/partner-scrape/data-access/): Full file shapes, the complete event field schema, the reconstruction contract, and a worked example of both files.
- [For Agents](https://league-infrastructure.github.io/partner-scrape/for-agents/): Terse, link-dense landing page for an LLM/agent — the same data URLs above, self-sufficient if reached directly.

## Publishing

- [Publish Your Events](https://league-infrastructure.github.io/partner-scrape/publish-events/): How a partner organization can publish events so this scraper ingests them well — several standard methods, ordered easiest-adoption-first.
